The 2025 Emilia Romagna Grand Prix (round 7, held at Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari on 18 May 2025) was won by Max Verstappen of Red Bull, who started from second on the grid. Lando Norris finished second and Oscar Piastri third.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
